articles.summary: Net income of $5.9 million and $11.2 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively Full-year revenue guidance revised to $115-118 million (from $118 - $128 million previously) due to delayed Etorel® (Nintedanib) rollout and government procurement-related uncertainty
